title: Personalized Basketball with Water Splash Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the energy of the court into your bedroom with the sports-themed bedding by Jeminise. This personalized comforter set features a dynamic design, making it a perfect gift for basketball players, kids, and sports fans of all ages.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own Name and Number for a truly unique sports bedding set.
  • Comfort & Warmth: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Superior Craftsmanship: Features smooth, fine, and compact stitching along the edges with advanced printing techniques to prevent fading.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly and fluffs up beautifully after washing.
  • Versatile Sizing: Available in multiple sizes including US Twin, Full, Queen, and King to fit any bed perfectly.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D15
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Basketball
Theme Art, Number, Personalized
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization 2 text inputs (Name and Number)
